name: @tradrl/body-sentiment-researcher
description: Sentiment/event researcher body contracts (Work Order T021): SENTIMENT_RESEARCHER_BODY — the read-only research body spec (agent-body BodyVersion structural mirror + research declaration: mission, capabilities, knowledge/tool policy, procedures, delegation, L8 authority scope, evaluation requirements, opaque substrate compatibility); the DECLARED-METHOD discipline (versioned aggregation/event-detection/confidence/report-composition method records — a sentiment number without a declared method is a typed error); the observation intake contracts (T038 news/social-signal emitter shape mirrors with availability quartets and T008 provenance blocks, the L4 as-of gate); and the evidence-complete outputs — SentimentReading, EventDigest, ResearchReport — every one carrying observation citations, method version, body version ref, tenant/project (L9/L12), with derived digest identities and byte-deterministic canonical serialization.
